fields.DESCRIPTION: Elevate your spiritual rituals with this beautifully crafted Brass Tumbler, designed for auspicious use in Pooja ceremonies and daily practices. Made from premium-quality brass, this tumbler (also known as Pooja Kailash Glass) is traditionally used for storing and offering sacred water (Gangajal), milk, or other ritualistic items. Its polished finish and elegant design make it not only functional but also a graceful addition to your Pooja ghar.
